method: Node VM execution with a minimal DOM; logic checks only, not visual or browser tests

checks.name: Old ordinary-page hash is clamped to the complete page
Every forward state maps to its intended original renderer state
Every reverse state restores the corresponding original state
Every ordinary page contains all former reveal blocks on entry
Retained mechanisms preserve source reveal thresholds
Print retains every selected mechanism state and every complete ordinary page
Legacy high step hashes, negative values and non-finite values remain bounded
Normal-page next crosses the page boundary in one action
Mechanism page entry, next, reverse and re-entry use the same source-state mapping
The table of contents includes every renumbered page exactly once
Double-clicks inside controls do not open figure zoom
Every JS and CSS index reference has a hash matching the current file
